groupings.title: Long-Horizon Execution
groupings.description: The post-specification stages of SPECIFY → PLAN → EXECUTE ↔ REPLAN → REPORT: planning from a spec or a stated goal, executing with evidence and dynamic replanning, and reporting the outcome without losing material state.
